lkcsor1I5A8gD038ncrBW.name: Etching: Rime
lkcsor1I5A8gD038ncrBW.description: She traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over, glows, and fades. The glass forgets nothing she draws.
lkcsor1I5A8gD038ncrBW.battleDescription: %user traces the north of the hall into the glass. It rimes over and fades, but the glass forgets nothing.

2pU7fdUPQPQQjyd19JDWA.name: Etching: Hail
2pU7fdUPQPQQjyd19JDWA.description: She taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. Each one glows and fades, and each one is remembered, exactly where it fell.
2pU7fdUPQPQQjyd19JDWA.battleDescription: %user taps a scatter of points into the glass, like hail. Each fades exactly where it fell.

eovhl9XyDQq1N19lDwr77.name: Etching: Ember
eovhl9XyDQq1N19lDwr77.description: She traces the south of the hall into the glass. It glows like an ember, then fades from sight, but not from the glass.
eovhl9XyDQq1N19lDwr77.battleDescription: %user traces the south of the hall into the glass. It fades from sight, not from the glass.

Pr7i3DK5KiRQRePy8Xw41.name: Etching: Seam
Pr7i3DK5KiRQRePy8Xw41.description: She traces a seam down the west wall. It glows, then sinks into the glass, which keeps it the way a scar keeps a cut.
Pr7i3DK5KiRQRePy8Xw41.battleDescription: %user traces a seam down the west wall. It sinks into the glass the way a scar keeps a cut.

nNUaP5r8r7UxYNiAtuF0l.name: Etching: Heart
nNUaP5r8r7UxYNiAtuF0l.description: She traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once, then fades. The glass keeps the rhythm long after the light is gone.
nNUaP5r8r7UxYNiAtuF0l.battleDescription: %user traces the heart of the hall into the glass. It beats once and fades; the glass keeps the rhythm.

-MtfLHClmIwSSGBIw9O7X.name: Recast: Heart
-MtfLHClmIwSSGBIw9O7X.description: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks, unmarked. The edges that never glowed are the only ones it does not remember. For a breath afterward her own guard hangs open.
-MtfLHClmIwSSGBIw9O7X.battleDescription: The glass remembers the heart, and the middle of the hall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.

54nmWiFXqvFW7u0vSG5zK.name: Recast: Seam
54nmWiFXqvFW7u0vSG5zK.description: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks, unmarked. The scar was always there for anyone who watched it sink in. Her guard stays open for a breath after the glass answers.
54nmWiFXqvFW7u0vSG5zK.battleDescription: The glass remembers the seam, and the west wall breaks. For a breath, her guard hangs open.
